data.body: Root validation reviewed the prior documentation epic tsunamic-wax-hog and the current documentation gates. That epic already repaired the README quickstart, completed the docs index, generated the CLI and MCP references, and added drift checks. Those completed items will not be proposed again unless current evidence shows a new defect. Current gates cover ADR numbering and indexing, environment registry drift, docs index completeness and relative links, README quickstart execution, generated CLI and MCP references, DCO identity, criteria vocabulary, conflict markers, file size, and selected contract tests. They do not enforce the operator prose constraints or documentation taxonomy. The comment hygiene guard scans only Python comments and docstrings in src, tests, and scripts for rot-prone historical tokens. It does not assess necessity, duplication, formal diction, paragraph shape, or non-Python surfaces. No project files changed.
